newsitem.title: USA: NEXSTAR, FUJISAWA GET FDA APPROVAL.
newsitem.headline: NEXSTAR, FUJISAWA GET FDA APPROVAL.

text.p: Fujisawa USA Inc and NeXstar Pharmaceuticals Inc said Tuesday that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has granted clearance to market AmBisome.
AmBisome liposome is an injection, which is for use as empirical therapy for presumed fungal infections in patients with depressed immune function and fever of unknown origin.
AmBisome also received marketing clearance from the FDA for treatment of patients with confirmed fungal infections.
NeXstar President and Chief Executive Patrick Mahaffy said in a statement that the company expects to launch the product by the end of the third quarter.
Fujisawa, a subsidiary of Fujisawa Pharmaceutical Co Ltd, licenses the AmBisome marketing and distributions rights in the U.S. and Canada from NeXstar.
NeXstar is to co-promote the product in the U.S. and also will be responsible for manufacturing it. AmBisome is currently approved and marketed by NeXstar in 29 other countries.
